description: The file defines a PHP controller class named ProjectActivityReportController within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It manages the preparation of a Vue.js component for displaying project activity reports, handling request parameters such as date range, project ID, and timesheet inclusion.

classes.name: ProjectActivityReportController
classes.description: Controller class that prepares a Vue.js component for the project activity report view, adding properties based on request query parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with properties for project activity report, based on HTTP request query parameters such as dates, project ID, and timesheet inclusion.
